entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's not working properly.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is completely inaccurate, just garbage data. I've checked it against other devices and it's wildly off.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I understand how frustrating it is when a feature doesn't perform as expected. I can transfer you to our technical support team; they have some advanced diagnostics they can run to resolve sensor issues.
Look, I really don't have time for all that. I've already wasted enough time trying to get it to work. At this point, I just want my money back. Can we please process a refund?
I understand your position. Of course, you want a product that works right out of the box. Let me just pull up your order details and review the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay, I see here that your order was delivered 20 days ago, on December 15th.
Yes, that's correct. So am I still able to return it?
Let me check the policy... Yes, absolutely. My knowledge base shows that all our items are eligible for a return for a full refund within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? That's great news. I was worried it might be an issue since it's been a few weeks. I was prepared to negotiate for at least a partial credit.

No need for that at all. Since you're within the 90-day window, I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I am sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Perfect. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
